rules.name: Runtime.exec Command Injection
rules.recommendation: Runtime.exec with a single string runs through a shell-like parser. Use ProcessBuilder with a List<String> of args.

rules.name: Java Deserialization Sink
rules.recommendation: ObjectInputStream / XMLDecoder execute attacker-controlled class loaders. Use JSON or protobuf, or wrap with a strict ObjectInputFilter.

rules.name: Weak Cipher Mode Or Algorithm
rules.recommendation: ECB, DES, 3DES, RC2 and RC4 are insecure. Use AES-GCM with a 12-byte random IV (Java AES/GCM/NoPadding or .NET AesGcm).

rules.name: Dynamic Class Loading
rules.recommendation: Class.forName with a non-literal argument allows attacker-chosen classes to be loaded. Resolve names against a fixed allowlist.

rules.name: .NET Insecure Formatter
rules.recommendation: These formatters can deserialize attacker types and run gadget chains. Use System.Text.Json or DataContractJsonSerializer.

rules.name: .NET SqlCommand With String Concatenation
rules.recommendation: Building SqlCommand text via concatenation or interpolation enables SQL injection. Use parameters with cmd.Parameters.AddWithValue.

rules.name: Log4Shell JNDI Lookup Literal
rules.recommendation: A literal ${jndi:...} string suggests a Log4Shell payload or test. Ensure Log4j is ≥ 2.17 and that JNDI lookups are disabled.
